component.name: Latitude
component.summary: Record your screen with a podcast audio studio

description.p: Record screens, windows, a camera, and up to two microphones. Shape your voice with EQ, compression, a de-esser, and a limiter. Keep microphones and desktop audio on synchronized, separate tracks for editing.
This Linux preview uses your desktop's screen-sharing picker on Wayland and PipeWire or PulseAudio for desktop sound. It targets desktop sessions, including SteamOS Desktop Mode.
